Preliminary Inquiry (PI) to identify and select companies that are interested in and capable of providing security services for the ALMA Observatory, located 18 km from San Pedro de Atacama, for the ESO Paranal Observatory, located 130 km south of Antofagasta, for the ESO La Silla Observatory located 160 km north of La Serena and for the ESO Premises located at Vitacura, in Chile. The scope of the services includes: For ALMA, the scope of the services primarily covers a 24 hr/day access control at the main entrance on the public road CH23, the base camp buildings and main access gate to the high site, at buildings and secondary access to the ALMA high site (at 5,000 meters above sea level) and regular patrolling of the site. For Paranal, the scope of the services primarily includes a 24 hr/day access control and a 12 hr/night shift patrol on the Observatory site. For La Silla, the scope is primarily the security of the site at night. For Vitacura, the scope of the services includes a 24 hr/day access control at the entrance gate. The services dedicated to ALMA, Paranal and Vitacura shall start on 1 December 2022 for a period of 31 months with options to extend it by up to 24 months more. The services dedicated to La Silla shall start on 1 July 2022 for a period of 36 months with options to extend it by up to 24 months more. The PI will be released in Q3/2021 to potential suppliers in Chile and will be followed by a Call for tender planned to be issued in Q4/2021. The contract is expected to be awarded in Q2/2022, to the bidder, which has submitted a fully compliant tender and offers the best value for money for ESO taking into account the quality and price of the offer. Preliminary Inquiry (PI) to identify and select companies that are interested in and capable of providing security services for the ALMA Observatory, located 18 km from San Pedro de Atacama, for the ESO Paranal Observatory, located 130 km south of Antofagasta, for the ESO La Silla Observatory located 160 km north of La Serena and for the ESO Premises located at Vitacura, in Chile. The scope of the services includes: For ALMA, the scope of the services primarily covers a 24 hr/day access control at the main entrance on the public road CH23, the base camp buildings and main access gate to the high site, at buildings and secondary access to the ALMA high site (at 5,000 meters above sea level) and regular patrolling of the site. For Paranal, the scope of the services primarily includes a 24 hr/day access control and a 12 hr/night shift patrol on the Observatory site. For La Silla, the scope is primarily the security of the site at night. For Vitacura, the scope of the services includes a 24 hr/day access control at the entrance gate. The services dedicated to ALMA, Paranal and Vitacura shall start on 1 December 2022 for a period of 31 months with options to extend it by up to 24 months more. The services dedicated to La Silla shall start on 1 July 2022 for a period of 36 months with options to extend it by up to 24 months more. The PI will be released in Q3/2021 to potential suppliers in Chile and will be followed by a Call for tender planned to be issued in Q4/2021. The contract is expected to be awarded in Q2/2022, to the bidder, which has submitted a fully compliant tender and offers the best value for money for ESO taking into account the quality and price of the offer.
